notes.title: LudonarraCon Event
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that we'll participate in panel at LudonarraCon, organized by Fellow traveller. 

Our topic? How alternate realities serve as a fascinating lens, allowing gamers to examine and question their own perspectives on our world! 

[b]On Friday May 10th, at 2PM PDT[/b] - that will be broadcast on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33025617/sale/ludonarracon]LudoNarraCon Steam page[/url].

All the best, can't wait to see you around!
Joy - Purple Meadows
